notes: Upstream-clone debugging task on pallets/click at parent commit 5b9630f50fde938b72ad8c99542efe3a6f5717e2 (real upstream bug, issue #3105). FuncParamType.convert catches ValueError raised by the wrapped conversion function but discards the exception's message, echoing only the raw input back in the resulting BadParameter error; the fix (PR #3211) uses str(exc) as the message and falls back to the raw input only when the exception message is empty. Agent must localise the bug in the real tree, fix it, keep the project's own test suite green, and only modify the minimal source surface; verifier runs the upstream regression test extracted from the fix commit into /opt/golden, the entire existing tests/ tree, and three authored hidden cases (full CLI invocation, non-string input, exact message preservation on bytes input) the upstream test does not use. Pure-Python (src/click/types.py), click 8.3.3, no network, small fast test suite. Both directions re-confirmed inside the task image before shipping.
